Run every pre-flight check on a figure and print one report

Source: R/checks.R
olinkviz_preflight.Rd

Runs the selected checks - size ([olinkviz_check_size()]), title fit ([olinkviz_check_fit()]), text sizes ([olinkviz_check_text()]), stroke weights ([olinkviz_check_lines()]) and colour-vision distinguishability ([olinkviz_check_colour()]) - against one journal and prints a one-screen report instead of raising a warning per finding.

Usage

olinkviz_preflight(
  plot,
  journal = getOption("olinkviz.journal", "nature"),
  width = "double",
  height = 100,
  units = c("mm", "in", "cm"),
  dpi = NULL,
  checks = .cm_all_checks
)

Arguments

plot

A ggplot or patchwork object.

journal

Any registered journal id (see [journal_specs()]).

width, height

Intended save size in `units`; `width` may be a width keyword for [journal_width()]. `height = "max"` uses the journal's maximum.

units

`"mm"` (default), `"in"` or `"cm"` for numeric `width`/`height`.

dpi

Optional raster resolution of the file you will submit.

checks

Which checks to run: any of `"size"`, `"fit"`, `"text"`, `"lines"`, `"colour"`.

Value

An object of class `olinkviz_preflight` (a list with `journal`, `width_mm`, `height_mm`, `status` - one of `"ok"`, `"note"`, `"warn"`, `"skip"` per check - and the raw `results`), invisibly after printing.

See also

Other checks: olinkviz_check_colour(), olinkviz_check_fit(), olinkviz_check_lines(), olinkviz_check_size(), olinkviz_check_text()

Examples

library(ggplot2)
p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg, colour = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_colour_olinkviz("okabe_ito") +
  labs(title = "Fuel economy") +
  theme_journal("nature")
olinkviz_preflight(p, "nature", width = "single", height = 70)
#> Pre-flight: Nature [nature] - 90 x 70 mm (3.54 x 2.76 in)
#>   size    OK    single column width; height within 170 mm
#>   fit     OK    title, subtitle and caption fit
#>   text    OK    6-7 pt across 17 text item(s)
#>   lines   OK    thinnest stroke 0.64 pt (minimum 0.25 pt)
#>   colour  OK    min CIEDE2000 12.1 (tritan vision, 3 colours)
#>   all clear
